dataset.note: Synthetic educational dataset; not real patient data.

hypothesis_tests.name: Smoking status vs diabetes (Chi-square test)
hypothesis_tests.H0: Smoking status and diabetes status are independent in this sample.
hypothesis_tests.H1: Smoking status and diabetes status are associated in this sample.
hypothesis_tests.interpretation: Insufficient evidence of an association at the 5% level.

hypothesis_tests.name: BMI by diabetes status (Welch two-sample t-test)
hypothesis_tests.H0: Mean BMI is equal for records with and without diabetes.
hypothesis_tests.H1: Mean BMI differs between records with and without diabetes.
hypothesis_tests.interpretation: Insufficient evidence of a mean BMI difference at the 5% level.

hypothesis_tests.name: Glucose level across age groups (one-way ANOVA)
hypothesis_tests.H0: Mean glucose level is equal across all age groups.
hypothesis_tests.H1: At least one age group has a different mean glucose level.
hypothesis_tests.interpretation: At least one age-group mean differs significantly at the 5% level.

correlation.interpretation: Positive linear correlation; p-value is below 0.05.
